question: Does one RapidRBF-owned double-double residual and accumulation refinement boundary around the unchanged instrumented faer 0.24.4 Bunch-Kaufman factor/solve route remove candidate-owned frozen-system forward-solution failures on the exact six-source boundary panel without weakening any authority or breaking resource, cancellation, reuse, or publication controls?

selected_candidate_boundary.name: instrumented-faer Bunch-Kaufman plus owned double-double refinement
selected_candidate_boundary.factorization: Reuse the exact issue-47 f64 Bunch-Kaufman factor bytes, pivot policy, correction solve, Par::Seq backend calls, pack schema, source lease, and instrumented allocation/cancellation seam unchanged.
selected_candidate_boundary.residual: For each frozen binary64 A and b, evaluate r=b-A*x in deterministic row-major order with error-free-transformation double-double multiplication and accumulation; candidate observations and certified reference centers are never inputs to residual construction.
selected_candidate_boundary.correction: Round each double-double residual once to binary64, solve A*delta=r with the unchanged factor, and add delta to x with double-double accumulation.
selected_candidate_boundary.terminal_rounding: After the frozen refinement stop rule, round each final double-double solution component once to nearest, ties-to-even binary64 before candidate-independent judgment.
stop_rule: or the double-double reduced backward error is exactly zero
or, after at least two corrections, backward error does not decrease and relative correction is at most binary64 epsilon
selected_candidate_boundary.prototype_primitive: The exact qd 0.8.0 closure in the accepted issue-45 source is the diagnostic implementation authority only; it is not adopted as a production dependency by this experiment.
selected_candidate_boundary.materialization_rule: Before any witness candidate entry, materialize one source/dependency/feature/toolchain binding implementing exactly this boundary, publish its complete content hash, and complete a zero-factor-call build/identity preflight on all four fixed native targets. Any semantic source change creates a new plan rather than a retry.

witness_corpus.category: M2-TH3 smallest-dimension failed and duplicate-source boundary
repaired M3-HERMITE 1k pass and rank/pivot boundary

unchanged_numerical_authority.system: Each frozen binary64 (A,b) is exact real data under ADR 0005.
unchanged_numerical_authority.reference: Reuse only the 18 already certified issue-47 centers and outward radii selected by the witness hashes; no reference regeneration or precision escalation occurs after candidate binding or entry.
unchanged_numerical_authority.judgment: The existing exact-dyadic PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE comparison is unchanged; INDETERMINATE is nonpassing.
conjunctive_gates: all three RHS families pass before pack and after reload

controls.baseline_replay: Before the refined route, the unchanged issue-47 candidate must reproduce the archived six-witness status vector on every target/profile: ordinal 0 PASS/PASS/PASS; 36 FAIL/FAIL/FAIL; 69 FAIL/FAIL/FAIL; 72 PASS/PASS/PASS; 106 FAIL/PASS/PASS; 150 FAIL/FAIL/FAIL. A mismatch is INVALID_UNJUDGED, not candidate evidence.
controls.factor_identity: The refined arm must use the same factor bytes, pivots, fingerprints, and reconstruction result as its paired unchanged baseline within each target/profile.
controls.alternative_routes: Do not rerun full-pivot LU or symmetric equilibration; accepted issue-45 evidence already shows neither raw route alone closes the 69 and 150 boundary failures.
pack_reload: truncated, corrupt, wrong-source, wrong-profile, and metadata-mismatch rejection before backend entry
pre-pack and post-reload rounded refined solutions bit-exact within a lane
controls.resource_denial: For every source, exact N-minus-one denial includes the existing factor schedule plus exactly 168*n additional owned refinement bytes for three RHS columns: three double-double n-by-3 buffers and one binary64 correction n-by-3 buffer. Denial occurs before operation or backend entry.
controls.allocation: All owned refinement allocations are planned before entry; zero hidden heap growth is allowed inside residual, correction, accumulation, or rounding loops; transient and permit residue must be zero.
controls.cancellation: Retain existing typed mid-factor and mid-correction-solve cancellation. Add typed mid-refinement cancellation with one poll before each residual row of each RHS family (at most n<=2047 double-double matrix terms unpolled), before and after every correction solve, and before publication. Cancellation publishes no partial refined solution and preserves the prior factor and prior solved correction.
controls.threads: Double-double residual and accumulation are caller-owned and use the configured outer worker grant without nested automatic pools; existing 1/12, 2/12, and 8/16 ceilings remain hard.
controls.scratch: Per-source isolated scratch is empty after success, denial, cancellation, or failure.

dispositions.REFINEMENT_ROUTE_SUPPORTED_FOR_FULL_CORP: Every identity, baseline, numerical, pre/post reload, resource, cancellation, thread, publication, and cleanup gate passes for every witness on every target/profile. This supports, but does not itself admit, a later separately frozen full-corpus refined-factor qualification.
dispositions.REFINEMENT_ROUTE_REJECTED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONL: Any valid candidate-owned numerical, reconstruction, backward, pack/reload, resource, cancellation, thread, publication, cleanup, crash, or timeout failure rejects this refinement route for promotion from the witness gate. Do not tune steps, precision, thresholds, witnesses, or binding after entry.
dispositions.INVALID_UNJUDGED: A missing/mismatched identity, reference, source, RHS, baseline replay, controller, lane, transport, or evidence closure prevents route judgment.

retry.before_candidate_entry: A proven external identity, build, transport, reference, baseline, or controller invalidity requires one complete unchanged retry.
retry.after_candidate_entry_candidate_owned: A candidate-owned failure is final REFINEMENT_ROUTE_REJECTED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY and is never retried.
retry.after_candidate_entry_external: A proven external controller/evidence invalidity permits at most one human-ratified complete unchanged replacement attempt.
